info.name: Content API Service
info.description: Content API V1. Every request sends Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}} (BRR/JWT), X-Workspace-Id and X-Request-Id. Run folders in order (the first request, GET /health, generates fresh ids for the run). Mint tokens with `npm run postman:env` (writes a git-ignored environment file) or `npm run token`.

exec: // ensure ids exist when a single request is run on its own
pm.test('postgres up', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('ready'); pm.expect(j.checks.postgres).to.eql('up'); });
pm.test('BIGINT ids are strings', () => { for (const k of ['id', 'pageId', 'sectionId']) pm.expect(j.data[k]).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: PATCH partial update (merge patch; null removes key)

exec: pm.test('patched field changed', () => pm.expect(j.data.content.description).to.eql('Create professional websites faster.'));

pm.test('untouched fields kept, nested object merged', () => { pm.expect(j.data.content.heading).to.eql('Build Better Websites'); pm.expect(j.data.content.primaryButton).to.eql({ label: 'Start Now', url: '/signup' }); });

item.name: Section types (Features / Images / Testimonials / Pricing / FAQ / CTA / Form)

exec: pm.test('content round-trips', () => pm.expect(j.data.content).to.eql({"heading":"Pricing","plans":[{"itemKey":"plan-basic","name":"Basic","displayPrice":"9","currency":"USD","billingLabel":"per month","description":"For individuals","features":["1 site","Email support"],"button":{"label":"Choose Basic","url":"/signup?plan=basic"}}]}));

pm.test('content round-trips', () => pm.expect(j.data.content).to.eql({"heading":"Frequently Asked Questions","items":[{"itemKey":"faq-1","question":"Can I edit this later?","answer":"Yes, you can update the content anytime."}]}));

pm.test('content round-trips', () => pm.expect(j.data.content).to.eql({"heading":"Ready to start?","description":"Launch your site today.","primaryButton":{"label":"Start free","url":"https://example.com/start"}}));
pm.test('content round-trips', () => pm.expect(j.data.content).to.eql({"heading":"Contact us","description":"We reply within one business day.","helperText":"We never share your email."}));

item.name: GET page-level check: Hero stays Hero

exec: pm.test('8 section contents keyed by sectionId', () => { pm.expect(j.data.count).to.eql(8); pm.expect(Object.keys(j.data.contents)).to.have.lengthOf(8); pm.expect(j.data.contents[pm.environment.get('sectionId')].sectionType).to.eql('hero'); });

item.name: GET bulk for page with no content

exec: pm.test('empty', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.count).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.items).to.eql([]); });

item.name: GET confirms stale write did not overwrite
PATCH a different section is independent (FAQ at its own revision)

exec: pm.test('FAQ revision 2 while Hero is higher', () => { pm.expect(j.data.revision).to.eql(2); pm.expect(j.data.content.items).to.have.lengthOf(1); });

pm.test('one snapshot per mutation, newest first', () => { pm.expect(j.data.items).to.have.lengthOf(cur); pm.expect(j.data.items[0].revision).to.eql(cur); pm.expect(j.data.items[cur - 1].revision).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.data.pagination.total).to.eql(cur); });

item.name: POST restore revision 1 as new revision

exec: pm.test('old content restored as NEW revision', () => { pm.expect(j.data.content.heading).to.eql('Build Websites'); pm.expect(j.data.revision).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('currentRevision')) + 1); });
pm.test('history appended', () => { pm.expect(j.data.pagination.total).to.eql(cur); pm.expect(j.data.items.map(i => i.revision)).to.eql(Array.from({ length: cur }, (_, i) => cur - i)); });

item.name: GET history for section without content -> 404
POST duplicate content to new section

exec: pm.test('independent new row at revision 1', () => { pm.expect(j.data.count).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.id).to.not.eql(pm.environment.get('contentId')); pm.expect(d.revision).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.sectionId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('dupTargetSectionId')); pm.expect(d.sourceSectionId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('sectionId')); });

item.name: PATCH duplicate does not touch source
GET source unchanged after copy edit
POST duplicate with wrong internal token -> 401
GET workspace the actor is not a member of -> 403
GET content of workspace 1001 from workspace 1002 -> 404 (not exposed)
PUT content of workspace 1001 from workspace 1002 -> 404
DELETE content of workspace 1001 from workspace 1002 -> 404
GET revisions of workspace 1001 from workspace 1002 -> 404
GET bulk page of workspace 1001 from workspace 1002 -> empty
POST workspaceId in body is ignored as proof of ownership
POST sectionType does not match content shape -> 422

exec: pm.test('did not pollute / no stray keys stored', () => { const c = pm.response.json().data.content; pm.expect(Object.keys(c).sort()).to.eql(['description', 'heading', 'mediaId', 'primaryButton', 'subheading']); pm.expect(({}).polluted).to.eql(undefined); });
pm.request.body.raw = JSON.stringify({ pageId: pm.environment.get('pageId'), sectionType: 'hero', content: { heading: 'x'.repeat(700 * 1024) } });

item.name: Response carries security headers and X-Request-Id
GET bulk page excludes deleted content

exec: pm.test('deleted row hidden', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.count).to.eql(9); pm.expect(d.contents).to.not.have.property(pm.environment.get('deleteSectionId')); });

item.name: POST re-create after soft delete -> 201 (fresh revision 1)
